rewrites.comment: Single-page app: React Router owns every path, but only index.html exists on disk. Without this, navigating to /app works while refreshing on /app is a 404 — the browser asks Vercel for a file that was never built. Rewrite (not redirect) so the URL is preserved for the router to read.

headers.comment: Hashed filenames are immutable, so they can be cached hard. index.html must not be, or a deploy leaves users on a stale bundle pointing at assets that no longer exist.
